calls.statement:
SELECT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units FROM fact_stock_week 
WHERE store_key = 30 AND product_key = 11 AND week_ending_date = '2026-10-04'

SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  fsw.week_ending_date,
  fsw.closing_units as closing_units
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON fsw.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON fsw.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 124 AND p.sku = 100011 AND fsw.week_ending_date = '2026-10-04'
